methods.description: Expand a positive power into its counted equal factors, or evaluate an already expanded product.
Evaluate index1 and positive whole-number powers of0/1 through the number of repeated factors.
Evaluate positive powers of10 as a1 followed by the index number ofzeros.
Count zeros in a power-of10 numeral to determine its positive index.
Express nonzero placevalue amounts using powers10, or evaluate and add them to form a numeral.
Evaluate each power independently and compare the resulting ordinary whole numbers; no new index law.
Count one factor2 for each elapsed doubling and compare successive counts for a first-passing threshold.
